negative_results: A REAL_DEVICE sweep acquires NOTHING: it raises NoElectricalHardwareError and its blocked receipt is PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN / BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT. No impedance analyzer, LCR bridge or crystal exists in this repository.
All five fault modes (clipping, drift, saturation, packet loss, missing samples) demonstrably corrupt the synthetic sweep, and a fault-injection sweep is refused for a clean BVD fit.

A BVD fit here recovers parameters PLANTED in a synthetic impedance sweep; it is a SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION and never a measured crystal. A parallel cable capacitance is otherwise absorbed into C0, and only the open-short-load de-embedding recovers the true C0.
An OSL calibration corrects only the frequency grid it was measured on; a shorter or shifted grid raises CalibrationLimitError, and a fixture with no shunt term cannot be de-embedded.

No physical measurement was performed: measured_here is nothing, the physical run is PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN, and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED. The software ceiling is MODEL_PREDICTION; a synthetic sweep tops out at SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION.
reopening_test: Reopen the electrical lane if: a REAL_DEVICE sweep ever returns samples instead of raising; a fitted BVD parameter is ever typed above SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION; a fault-injection sweep is accepted for a clean fit; an OSL calibration corrects a grid it was not measured on; or the planted R, L, C, C0, f_s, f_p, Q are not recovered within tolerance from a clean synthetic sweep. The lane is promoted off PREREGISTERED_NOT_RUN only when a physical crystal is swept on a calibrated impedance analyzer, its raw complex sweep and OSL calibration captured with a clock binding, an environment log and an uncertainty budget.
